protocol.ranking: train only: total_R / max(5, drawdown_R), minus 0.5 per negative temporal third; minimum 10 trades per third
protocol.promotion: winner only, no fallback search: holdout PF>1, total_R>baseline, DD<=1.5*baseline, trades>=40
protocol.caveat: Historical final 30% already inspected in earlier tasks; not fresh untouched out-of-sample evidence
protocol.costs: historical spread, 2-point slippage, commission 7 per lot, no swap
